Focus areas requested: XSS via the new user-typed garment name (Название) flowing into JSX rendering; confirmation that client-side validation is not the only defense (backend validateSettings still applies); confirmation that nothing NEW worsens the pre-existing, accepted deepseek.go market-feedback prompt risk.
summary:
This task adds GarmentAddForm (a form component collecting Название/Мин. цена per шт/База,мин/Коэфф. сложности) and wires DeleteRowButton into the two existing per-mode Изделия row lists. This is the first task in the feature that actually renders a user-typed name that reached the app through the new add-form path, so the XSS check requested by the lead is the central focus here. Result: clean. The added garment name is rendered exactly once as `{name}` inside `{name}` (Panel.jsx:1170, quick mode; Panel.jsx:1230, masterpiece mode) — both are pre-existing interpolation sites the diff does not change; the diff only adds a sibling `
` wrapper and a `DeleteRowButton` next to each. Grepped the entire file for `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, template-string HTML construction, and `eval`/`new Function` — zero matches anywhere in Panel.jsx, not just in the diff. React's default JSX text-child escaping means a name like `` renders as inert text in both the row list and the form's own text input value binding (`value={draft.name}` — a controlled input, not `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`). No stored, reflected, or DOM-based XSS introduced. Second focus area: confirmed `validateSettings` in server/internal/service/costing.go:593-654 is completely untouched by this diff (this task's stated scope is client-only, `client/src/pages/Panel.jsx`, and `git show c0a11bc --stat` confirms only that one file changed) and still runs server-side on every POST /api/v1/users/settings, independently re-checking `strings.TrimSpace(name) == ""`, `BaseMinutes > 0`, `ComplexityCoeff > 0`, `QuickPrice >= 0` for every garment key regardless of what the client sent or validated — so the new client-side validateGarmentFields/isDuplicateName checks (from Task 2, invoked by GarmentAddForm.handleAdd at Panel.jsx:405-434) are correctly defense-in-depth, not the sole gate; a request forged directly against the API (bypassing the UI entirely) still gets the same backend rejection it always did. Third focus area: server/internal/service/deepseek.go is untouched by this diff (confirmed via the git show stat — client-only commit) and still builds its market-feedback prompt via `strings.Join(sortedKeysFromGarments(settings.Garments), ", ")` (deepseek.go:404) with no escaping/sanitization of garment names, exactly as before Task 3. This task does not add any new server-reachable path to deepseek.go, does not change name-length limits, does not change what characters are accepted (validateGarmentFields validates only the three numeric fields — base_minutes, complexity_coeff, quick_price — never the name string's content beyond blank/duplicate checks, same as Task 2 already established). The tech-spec's own Risks table already documents this as accepted pre-existing behavior newly made reachable via a discoverable UI action (previously only via hand-crafted API calls) rather than a new vulnerability class, and this task's GarmentAddForm is that reachability being realized as designed — it does not add anything beyond what tech-spec already scoped and the user approved. No new findings that require action; one informational note below for the record.

findings.location: client/src/pages/Panel.jsx:1170, 1230 (`{name}` inside the two Изделия `.map(([name, item]) => ...)` row blocks) and :1201 (`` in `GarmentAddForm`)
findings.description: Verified the specific scenario the lead asked to confirm: a garment name typed into the new `GarmentAddForm` (e.g. `` or ``) flows through `handleAddGarment` into `settings.garments[name]`, and back out through plain `{name}` JSX text-child interpolation at both existing row-render sites this task added a `DeleteRowButton` next to. React escapes JSX text children by default (renders as literal text via a text node, not parsed as markup), so this executes as inert text in the DOM, not as script. No `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `innerHTML`, or raw-HTML-string construction exists anywhere in Panel.jsx (confirmed via grep across the whole file, not just the diff). The controlled `` in the add-form itself is likewise safe — React sets the DOM `.value` property, not `innerHTML`.
findings.recommendation: None required — no vulnerability. Forward note for Task 4 (Усложнения/Операции, same pattern) and Task 5 (Скидки за количество, no free-text name field there): keep using plain `{name}` JSX interpolation for any further user-typed strings rendered into rows; the moment any future change introduces `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` or manual HTML-string building for these fields, this class of risk would be reintroduced.
